context: Revalidated 2026-11-11: still required and not started. origin/develop has no Tinybird code. The spike needs a Tinybird workspace and token from the owner and uses a live vendor service. Docs for new platforms moved to the benchbox-site repo (docs/development/adding-new-platforms.md).
description:
Validate the four Tinybird unknowns before any adapter code: (1) query path via clickhouse-connect against clickhouse.<region>.tinybird.co:443 with workspace name + token; (2) ingest path: create a Data Source from BenchBox .tbl data via the Data Source API and measure import latency; (3) schema translation: BenchBox DDL to Tinybird-inferred schema, including TPC-H trailing delimiters and null markers; (4) namespace reality: queries must target the workspace database, only 4 databases visible, subset of system tables.

DECISION GATE: end of item records go/no-go for the adapter. Go requires all four unknowns resolved with evidence. No-go records the blocking fact and defers the adapter, same as the GizmoSQL pattern of documenting negatives.

Guardrails: tokens in env only, never committed; no production workspace writes; read-only query probing plus one scratch Data Source for ingest.
